_comment: Sourced ownership claims about tracked outlets (D-042).
Every claim carries its own citation. A claim we cannot cite is not recorded,
and 'unknown' is a correct and common answer — see how Ground News itself
renders 'unknown' for Dinamani. Nothing here is inferred: an owner's politics
is recorded only when a named source documents it, never deduced from an
outlet's coverage, which would be the bias labelling pillar 2 forbids.
owner        : the company, trust or group that publishes the outlet.
owner_group  : the controlling group, where one owner runs several outlets.
This is what makes coverage concentration computable.
ownership_type: Ground News's published eight-category taxonomy, adopted and
attributed to them. Recorded only where the legal form is
political_affiliation: documented links only, one citation per claim.
Human-confirmation path (DESIGN section 6): a person edits this file, the
importer validates and applies. No pipeline writes these.
